verdict.rationale: Groq's docs make only qualitative speed claims ("Fast LLM inference", service tiers to "tune for latency, throughput") and publish no tokens-per-second or latency figures. Users did post concrete hands-on throughput numbers (~491 T/s and 450+ tps on Mixtral 8x7B, ~200 tps on Llama 2 70B), and Groq staff gave architectural explanations for the low latency. Missing for 10: first-party published tokens/sec or latency benchmarks per model, latency metrics such as TTFT or p50/p99, a load-testing or benchmarking guide, and recent independent benchmark coverage.
